comments.value: I think it would be nice to be able to select between having the yellow border, yellow name,  yellowborder and name or have them show up as normal without any yellow element
A combination with the border, as well as returning the text itself to yellow, is a perfectly fine solution in my opinion

Without the yellow text I can no longer find my friends in the instance list, and it's difficult to see them in world even when they're relatively close.  The gold name border is also fairly hard to distinguish.

The obvious answer is that keeping text white makes it safer for all the new nameplate backgrounds. A yellow nameplate background would clash. But I agree that a tiny border makes it harder to scan an instance for your friends and we need a better indicator
I'm right there with you. When friends change their usernames, the yellow text helps tell me that I know them in a crowd.

details: Just quite simple, can we have the yellow text for names still in primarily the nameplate? usually i look for yellow names when finding where my friends are if they are nearby in a world. the current yellow border is harder to see, especially if someone is talking. I think having yellow names with the yellow border could be good though
title: [1878] Keep the yellow names for friends in ui/nameplates
